26/S0.subgoal: Explain the distinction between sensing and perception and the role of the cerebral cortex in processing stimuli.

26/S1.subgoal: Describe the structure of neurons and how they form a complex network in the brain.

26/S2.subgoal: Explain how hierarchical processing allows the brain to detect increasingly complex patterns from sensory inputs.

26/S3.subgoal: Describe how perception involves combining real-time sensory input with long-term memory and experience.

26/S4.subgoal: Explain the concept of proprioception as a sense of bodily position and effort.

26/S5.subgoal: Explain how sensory conflicts in XR, such as vection, lead to cyber sickness and loss of presence.

26/S6.subgoal: Summarize how understanding human factors influences the design of immersive XR systems.
